title: Creamy German Cucumber Salad Recipe – Omas Norddeutscher Gurkensalat
ldName: Creamy German Cucumber Salad Recipe – Oma's Norddeutscher Gurkensalat
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ teaspoon (1 g) dill, preferably fresh (or more to taste)
ldInstructionsRaw: Put the thin cucumber slices into a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate.
In a small bowl, mix the dressing ingredients: sour cream, dill, lemon juice, and sugar. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate.
Just before serving, pour the creamy dressing over the thinly sliced cucumbers and mix.

fresh dill
weed, or to taste
